Day 2 — morning

🔔 The Drowned Bell

Night falls on day seven. The sea goes still — so still the gulls stop mid-cry.

From the lighthouse, with no keeper inside, a bell tolls. Once. Twice. Seven times.

June stands at the farmhouse door, and for the first time in sixty-two years, she does not flinch.

"The Tithe is due," she says. "But this time, the island chose someone who knows."

Year 1 is done 🌙

The longest night has passed, and the year turns. The Tithe is due this year — the bell will ring for someone. But the farm is yours, the villagers are yours, and the island keeps living.

🏝️ Tidehollow

A full year on Tidehollow — five acts, one Tithe

You're the new farmer on an island that feeds everyone… for a price. Farm, fish, sell, and talk to the villagers. On day 7, the bell rings — and the year goes on from there.

Move: left stick or WASD / arrows.
ACT button (or Space): hoe, plant, water, harvest, fish, talk, sell, sleep.
